claims.quote: Bagrichthys obscurus Ng, 1999. Maximum size 249 mm (9.8") SL. Type locality: Lam Chi, 1.5 km below highway 23 bridge, 4 km west of Selaphum, Roi Et Province, Thailand.
Described from Roi Et province, northeastern Thailand and distributed throughout the Chao Phraya, Bang Pakong and Mekong watersheds.
Recorded from parts of the latter in Cambodia and Vietnam and presumably also occurs in Laos.
